content.comment_body: Is it possible to log in to [product_name] Access Tool and a web browser at the same time?
I want to record a log file using MS Excel with [product_name] Access Tool, but it's not possible if another login session is active at the same time.
Yes, this should be possible regardless of whether you use the basic or extended web server.
Please check the attached video for details.
Thank you [user_name]. I only see a blank video in your upload. Could you check and re-upload it?
I've tested it and the video seems fine.
The video works for me too. Initially, I had issues viewing it on my Android mobile phone, but on a PC it's fine. Thank you. I'll test it myself later.
I've tried it, and Excel loses communication with [product_name] when another login session begins.
In my video, you can see it working for me. I can't say why it's not working for you. Maybe consider opening a support request.

Hi, try using Firefox and set the maximum used connections to 2, then test again. [product_name] supports 6 connections for web browsers. If all are used, there might not be any left for the Access Tool. According to the [product_name] manual, both Access Tool and web browser use port 80 if not remote. By limiting Firefox to 1 connection, it's possible to have up to 6, so the server supports 6 connections in total. If you use a browser that takes all 6, Access Tool may lose its connection. Note: Firefox allows limiting the number of connections via Settings > General > Performance. Hopefully this helps.
Hello [user_name], are you able to access [product_name] with two different devices simultaneously? For example, using a laptop for the Access Tool and a smartphone for the web server?
Dear [user_name], currently, I can't log in with more than one session. Only one is possible. When someone else logs in, the currently logged-in user is disconnected.
Your reply doesn't address my question.

[user_name] Yes, the behavior is the same. PC with [product_name] Access Tool and mobile phone, or even two mobile phones—but only one can log in to a custom page. Only a single login session is allowed; new logins kick out previous ones.
[product_name] Access Tool disconnects when a new login session from a mobile device begins. It seems [product_name] only allows one active session from any device.
My test was from a single device—a PC. I believe you can't log in with two devices at the same time. Consider submitting a support request.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum members are experiencing issues when trying to use [product_name] Access Tool for data logging with MS Excel while also being logged in to the web server with another session. Communication between Excel and the device stops when a new browser session logs in. While some report successful parallel use, others see disconnections, pointing to possible limitations in the number of allowed connections or device configuration.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to simultaneously use both the [product_name] Access Tool (for Excel logging) and the web server interface in a browser without interruptions or forced disconnections.
